season.name: Winter
season.line: The dark season is holy ground.

movement.name: The Hidden Seed
movement.line: What looks dormant is being kept.

days.t: A child hidden for three months
x: And she conceived, and bore a male child; and having seen that he was fair, they hid him three months.
And when they could no longer hide him, his mother took for him an ark, and besmeared it with bitumen, and cast the child into it, and put it in the ooze by the river.

And Samuel said to Jessæ, Hast thou no more sons? And Jessæ said, [There is] yet a little one; behold, he tends the flock. And Samuel said to Jessæ, Send and fetch him, for we may not sit down till he comes.
And he sent and fetched him: and he was ruddy, with beauty of eyes, and very goodly to behold. And the Lord said to Samuel, Arise, and anoint David, for he is good.
And Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward: and Samuel arose, and departed to Armathaim.
And He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and He was subject to them. And His mother was keeping all these matters in her heart.
And Jesus continued to advance in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

days.t: Hidden in the shadow of his hand
x: and he has made my mouth as a sharp sword, and he has hid me under the shadow of his hand; he has made me as a choice shaft, and he has hid me in his quiver;

days.t: Your life is hidden with Christ
x: For you⁺ died, and your⁺ life has been hidden with Christ in God.

days.t: In the wilderness until the day
x: And the child continued to grow and to become strong in spirit; and he was in the wilderness until the day of his appearance to Israel.
